profile.headline: Software Engineer at OneHouse
profile.summary: An aspiring software engineer that have always dreamt of going to the Silicon Valley. Now that I’m here, I’m looking for an opportunity that could allow me to utilize my full potential and make a change for the better

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led a six-month initiative to deliver configurable MFA timeouts, enabling enterprise customers to tailor authentication settings (e.g., timeout durations, factor requirements). Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders and mentored junior engineers. Supported an estimated $8M in contract value. 
• Delivered the migration of MFA services to Google Cloud Platform as part of a company-wide infrastructure transformation. Led a complete microservices refactor, coordinated cross-team resource planning, with meticulous planning and rollout to ensure HA to our core system.  
• Led a full architectural overhaul of shared link token generation, improving how contextual data of shared links is embedded in tokens. Managed multi-team collaboration across several microservices and internal platform libraries.  
• Member of the Identity Security Foundation team, which oversee the architecture and design of login and token systems at Box. Regularly on-call to resolve critical incidents, ensuring system reliability and security.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned and delivered an automated license scanning pipeline for new database engines (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL), ensuring compliance with Amazon’s open-source licensing standards for RDS Outposts.  
• Contributed to the development and execution of system tests to validate the stability and functionality of RDS on Outposts, ensuring high-quality releases aligned with AWS standards.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to complete key operational tasks and ensure production readiness and a smooth launch.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Part of the team that shipped Inventory Manager, a standalone microservice that manage thousands of inventories every day transitioning from monolith  
• Led the debugging effort that investigates and resolves mismatches for comparisons between the new microservice Inventory Manager and the current monolith ZAPI

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development of new core features for the main platform, ensuring seamless integration and functionality. 
• Collaborated on the design and implementation of the primary API, administrative interfaces, and the main web store. 
• Developed back-end solutions utilizing Node.js, Redis, PostgreSQL, and Chai to optimize performance and scalability.
• Engineered front-end components using Vue.js, Vuex, and Jest, enhancing user experience and interface reliability.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-Developed the website for Miami's Physics lab.

-Created a file system that allowed static pages to be auto-generated from folders containing contents.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
- Assisting student during lecture and lab for any technical problem or understanding of the course.

- Grading student homework and labs.

- Assisting student with any problem outside of class relating to the course.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
- Worked on Quyet de, a voting app.
- Created the admin website for Quyet de using Koa, Jquery to manage users, posts, etc.
- Worked on Quyet de's API that supports the admin page, Quyet de and Quyet de live using Koa, Knex and Redis. 
- Created Quyet de live, a live version of Quyet de that show poll in real time using Koa, WebSocket and Vue.
- Worked on a legacy admin page by adding new functionalities and fixed bugs using React, Flux, Knex and Koa.
- Tested Money Lover open API.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.locationName: 11 Chau Long, Ba Đinh District , Ha Noi
positions.description:
Developed a system to detect, track, classify and measure the speed and flow rate of vehicle.

Trained cascade classifier for vehicle detection on specific camera.

Created a program to gather images of specific object for detection to speed up the training sample collecting process.

Created a testing environment for cascade quality.

Organize meeting for the boards.
